builds.name: Reference: AP attack experiment
builds.goal: Reference for Kayle: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A level-scaling attack carry who grows from limited early reach into ranged wave attacks, using healing and invulnerability to preserve attack time. Use the recorded level/form and passive wave state. Compare AP/on-hit with crit at the actual attack range; R invulnerability preserves attack time but has a real cooldown. AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route.
builds.summary: AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route.
testPlan: Kit question for Kayle: Use the recorded level/form and passive wave state. Compare AP/on-hit with crit at the actual attack range; R invulnerability preserves attack time but has a real cooldown.

Start with the early core (Nashor, then Rageblade) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Lower physical attack damage and limited health; verify the kit's AP/on-hit behavior first.

The route fails Kayle's stated kit question: Use the recorded level/form and passive wave state. Compare AP/on-hit with crit at the actual attack range; R invulnerability preserves attack time but has a real cooldown.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Lower physical attack damage and limited health; verify the kit's AP/on-hit behavior first.
Full cost 16,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Nashor, then Rageblade. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Blessing Damage Charge
builds.summary: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement.
builds.goal: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement.
builds.hypothesis: W heals both Kayle and an ally and has AP-scaled movement. Q/actual attacks can store Helia champion damage before W; Staff grants AP/haste after allied healing, supporting E passive magic and a later W. R gives invulnerability access to preserve the beneficiary.
testPlan: Required state: W affects another ally after Kayle deals champion damage; record level/Exalted state.
Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Utility investment reduces carry damage and W mana/cooldown limits repetition.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Self-only healing does not satisfy Helia/Staff allied trigger.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Exalted Wave Threshold
builds.summary: Separate wave, E and ordinary attack damage above and below 40%.
builds.goal: Separate wave, E and ordinary attack damage above and below 40%.
builds.hypothesis: At level 11 Exalted attacks launch AP magic waves and at 16 Exalted is permanent. E also adds AP magic and missing-health damage; Shadowflame tests qualifying low-health wave/E packets while Riftmaker rewards real combat duration. Nashor supports actual attacks and Q removes both resists before delivery.
testPlan: Required state: Level 11 with five P stacks or level 16; target below 40% for Shadowflame.
Separate wave, E and ordinary attack damage above and below 40%; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Pre-Exalted state removes waves or kiting prevents ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade on-hit repetition is not proof of duplicated fire waves.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Riftmaker, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
